articleTitle: Why Your Old Deodorant Stopped Working in Menopause
imageHeadline: Why Your Deodorant Stopped Working in Menopause
imageSubtext: See what actually works now—deodorant vs. antiperspirant explained
pinTitle: why deodorant stops working during menopause and what to use instead
pinDescription: Hormonal shifts in menopause change your sweat chemistry and volume, which is why your old deodorant may not cut it anymore. Learn the difference between deodorant and antiperspirant for menopause sweat, plus what actually works now that your body has changed.
